entries.zh: 巴不得：极其盼望、恨不得（字面含「求而不得」之意）。
entries.en: to long for eagerly; to wish one could have (lit. 'to love and not be able').
entries.notes: 西语词头「amar no poder」语义含混（疑为「爱而不得」），R 栏音写作 pūⁿ kē 与「得」常读不合；义从汉字「巴不得」取。

entries.zh: 揉（面）、搓揉；搔、抓挠。
entries.en: to knead (dough), to rub; to scratch.
entries.notes: 汉字栏「搔」为抓挠，与西语 amasar（揉面）及闽南语 gō（揉）不合，疑栏位错置或借字；义从西语与 M 栏。

entries.zh: 揉圆：用手把面团搓揉成圆团、圆子。
entries.en: to knead dough into round balls with the hands.
entries.notes: H 栏「授員」当为借音字（員=ûiⁿ，即「圓」），M gō ûiⁿ 正合西语「如做圆面包」；汉字栏用字与常形不合。

entries.zh: 用手搓揉使成小丸（如捏蜡搓丸）〔汉字、官话两栏残缺，原词存疑〕
entries.en: to knead with the hands into little pellets, as wax into pills (Chinese equivalent missing in the original).
entries.notes: H、R 两栏原空，仅存西语释义与闽南语 lō̃-chiy，无法回拟汉字，故仅译西语义。

entries.zh: 打面浆：把面粉加水搅打成糊；揉面。
entries.en: to beat flour and water into a batter; to knead dough.

entries.zh: 龙涎；龙涎香（琥珀）。
entries.en: ambergris; amber.

entries.zh: 龙涎香（贵重香料）。
entries.en: precious ambergris.

entries.zh: 奢侈、骄奢；有野心、近乎傲慢。
entries.en: extravagant, lavish; ambitious, proud.

entries.zh: 奢华：讲排场、好炫耀（其实贫穷）。
entries.en: ostentatious, given to display (though poor).

entries.zh: 奢侈：挥霍、用度骄奢。
entries.en: extravagant in spending; prodigal.
entries.notes: M 栏「«Balchy.»」为原稿夹注或衍文，未据以释义。

entries.zh: 奋发、奋勉（有志气而力争）。
entries.en: ambitious; to strive, exert oneself.
entries.notes: 西语 ambicioso 与「奮（奋勉）」义稍宽；R 栏 hūn 亦非「奮」之常读。

entries.zh: 舐口舐舌：舔嘴咂舌，形容贪馋垂涎、贪求无厌。
entries.en: to lick one's lips and tongue; greedy, covetous, craving more.
entries.notes: M 栏末尾「+」为符号残留，R 栏对音与 H 字面参差；义从 H「舐口舐舌」及西语「贪求日增」推定。

entries.zh: 志：志向、企图心。
entries.en: aspiration, ambition; that which one aspires to.

entries.zh: 志气：抱负、雄心。
entries.en: high aspiration; ambition.

entries.zh: 志向：心之所向、一心向往。
entries.en: aim, aspiration; to set one's heart on.

entries.zh: 见大：自视甚高、目空一切，贪求无厌。
entries.en: to aim too high; arrogant and insatiable.

entries.zh: 骄奢人：骄横奢侈之人。
entries.en: an arrogant and extravagant person.

entries.zh: 目空大：眼界高而贪求无厌、目空一切。
entries.en: greedy and overreaching; to look down on all.

entries.zh: 兼：两者兼具、同时。
entries.en: both; at once, simultaneously.

entries.zh: 兼又：两者一并、又兼。
entries.en: both, and also; together.
entries.notes: H 栏「蒹」当为「兼」之形讹，M/R 均读 kiam/jiān 可证。
